reviewed_by: Claude: Butler independent review denial and sign-off guard precision
reason: Production root cause: a harness-backed Butler at Act called nebula.supervisor.independent_review with project-relative evidence paths; the review reached _read_evidence, which raised GuardrailViolation(not_configured) because NEBULA_BUTLER_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_ROOTS was unset, and even with roots set the relative paths would have resolved against Core's process cwd (evidence_outside_roots). The PermissionError surfaced only as a bare permission_denied. Fix (butler_independent_review): the goal's own project workspace is always an evidence root, relative paths resolve there (realpath before the root check, so .. and symlink escapes are refused), configured roots remain extra absolute roots, the workspace resolver is injected by the execution kernel (native_workspace: engagement workspace_path, else the managed workspace) and its failure is recorded and falls back to configured roots; the tool handler converts GuardrailViolation and ReviewUnavailable into a GuidedToolError with error_code independent_review.<rule>, a Core-authored problem/remedy (never the cited path or reviewer output) and before_execution for pre-reviewer refusals. Second fix (butler_review_gating.detect_forged_signoff): the case-insensitive 'INDEPENDENT CLOSURE REVIEW' header pattern matched ordinary prose naming the review, and an authority+approval pair with a pending marker was re-flagged by any approval word or colon; detection is now per clause, the header pattern matches only Core's uppercase header or its '(model):' shape, 'sign-off: pending'-style values and irrealis contexts ('must be approved by', 'do not record ... accepted until') are not claims, while stated verdicts/completed approvals still are. Butler's own check-ins stay guarded (Butler cannot produce a reviewer record). Docs: butler-supervisor-powers review flow, evidence-roots row, refusal codes and sign-off rule; product knowledge rebuilt (no change: that doc is not a knowledge source). Python selects the new suite, the suites of the edited modules and their consumers (supervisor powers, review gating, fabrication guard, goal runtime routing, harness parity) and the product-knowledge digest and supervisor-powers rows. Review follow-up: _PENDING_VALUE counts none/no/n/a only as the whole value (pending/requested/awaiting/not yet/to be may lead), _IRREALIS looks back at most three plain words, never across punctuation, and no longer treats bare 'no' as irrealis; semicolons no longer split clauses; a bare completed approval word outside an irrealis context is a strong claim (eight reviewer strings are must-flag tests, false-positive cases kept). _read_evidence checks the path lexically, then opens it component by component with O_NOFOLLOW via workspace._open_directory_chain and O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK on the leaf, requires a regular file (fstat), keeps at most MAX_FILE_BYTES+1 bytes and hashes the whole file in 1 MiB chunks from the same descriptor; links, folders and special files are refused as evidence_not_regular_file. Tests cover a simulated post-check symlink swap, symlinked file and folder, a sibling project's absolute path, and an oversized file.
exclusions: execution_kernel gains one line wiring the existing native_workspace resolver into the reviewer; no kernel-construction test was added: building the full app in a test is not cheap (a minimal create_app probe did not finish within 120 s), so the wiring is checked by review and the resolver path is covered with an injected resolver in test_butler_review_denial. test_product_knowledge.py::test_product_search_finds_headless_core_and_paired_butler_cli fails on unmodified main and is not selected. No UI, native or Playwright change. No live Core, harness or reviewer call. No full-suite approval.
